x-docsfab-enum-descriptions.critical: Unsafe to publish; causes incorrect operation, disclosure, security/compliance risk, or failure of the primary task.
x-docsfab-enum-descriptions.major: Materially incomplete or misleading but not immediately dangerous.
x-docsfab-enum-descriptions.minor: Localized issue with limited impact on task success.

x-docsfab-enum-descriptions.technical_accuracy: A claim, API name, value, behavior, or version conflicts with an approved source.
x-docsfab-enum-descriptions.source_grounding: A consequential claim lacks approved evidence.
x-docsfab-enum-descriptions.completeness: Required information or a required format region is missing.
x-docsfab-enum-descriptions.task_success: A user cannot complete the documented procedure as written.
x-docsfab-enum-descriptions.example_validity: Required code or commands are invalid, inconsistent, or not reproducible.
x-docsfab-enum-descriptions.information_architecture: Structure prevents readers from finding or understanding required information.
x-docsfab-enum-descriptions.style_compliance: The document violates an explicit style or terminology rule.
x-docsfab-enum-descriptions.security_compliance: Content violates an explicit security, confidentiality, legal, or publication rule.
